definitions.gloss: the other side; opposite side; far side
definitions.explanation: the side that is across from where one is standing or looking

examples.english: There's a house on the other side of the river.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}こう{側|がわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}って→渡る：02441_wataru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please cross to the other side of the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}こう{側|がわ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I heard a voice from the other side of the wall.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{向|む}こう (over there, the other side) + ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {向|む}こう - over there (general direction)
- {向|む}こう{側|がわ} - the other side (specific side)
- ⟦{反対側|はんたいがわ}→反対側：16780_hantaigawa⟧ - opposite side
- ⟦{裏側|うらがわ}→裏側：03042_uragawa⟧ - back side, reverse side

COMMON PATTERNS:
~⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side) compounds:
- ⟦こちら{側|がわ}→こちら側：22602_kochiragawa⟧ - this side
- あちら⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ - that side
- ⟦{右側|みぎがわ}→右側：24189_migigawa⟧ - right side
- ⟦{左側|ひだりがわ}→左側：22836_hidarigawa⟧ - left side
- ⟦{外側|そとがわ}→外側：05450_sotogawa⟧ - outside
- ⟦{内側|うちがわ}→内側：05449_uchigawa⟧ - inside
